blocks.text: Thank you, that helps. Between your note and Amy Carter's, I think we have what we need to move. The names you sent let me shape the interviews for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} around the people whose voice carries the message furthest, and Amy's marked draft will reach you this week to read alongside them.

On the short call Amy raised, I think it is worth doing ahead of the interviews, so we walk in aligned. If a half hour early next week suits you, tell me which day sits best and I will build everything else around it.
I will send three interview windows for each of your executives by tomorrow and hold them for your word. Nothing on the Suarez-Jones side is booked until you confirm, Jennifer Herrera.
